text: Paper and book atlas / 2005 Evaporation and condensation of H I clouds in thermally bistable interstellar media: semi-analytic description of isobaric dynamics of curved interfaces Nagashima, Koyama & Inutsuka · 2005 MNRAS Letters 361, L25–L29 Reference listed · scope proposed Curvature modifies evaporation and condensation for cylindrical, spherical, and general fronts under an isobaric approximation. Scope in this archive. Candidate: evaluate the semi-analytic curvature correction and compare planar, cylindrical, and spherical limits using a small ODE calculation. Keep the polynomial heat-loss model distinct from later realistic fits. Source review: Bibliography and abstract checked; equations and target figures require a dedicated audit.
